interface.title: RapidQuant — Point-of-Care Bioanalytical AI (Lateral Flow Immunoassay Quantification)
interface.field: Bioanalytical chemistry / point-of-care diagnostics (lateral-flow immunoassays with gold-nanoparticle labels)
interface.stage_of_work: Data analysis and assay validation: turning photos of test strips into band signals, calibration curves, detection limits and sample concentrations
interface.what_it_is_for: Photograph or upload lateral-flow test strips and get automatic strip cropping, Control/Test band densitometry traces, T/C ratios, a 4PL/5PL standard curve with CLSI EP17-A2 LoB/LoD/LLoQ/ULoQ, replicate %CV and recovery, and concentrations of unknown samples with prediction intervals.

data.note: Most strips came from the app's built-in 'Quick-Load Benchmark Library' buttons (+ Blank, + 0.1 ng, + 0.5 ng, + 1.0 ng), which load the bundled sample JPEGs. I also uploaded 1_1_AuNP.jpeg and 0.5_1_AuNP.jpeg through 'Device Photos/Files'. The app read each concentration from the filename. In the LoD run every replicate at a given concentration was the same bundled image, so SD = 0 and %CV = 0, LoD and EC50 came out as 0.0000, and the 0.1/0.5/1 levels were FLAGGED on recovery. In the Unknown run the replay saw a constant ±0.0050 SD on levels that had only one strip, which does not look like a real measured SD. The 10x Patient_A unknown came out at 1.404 ± 21.461 ng/mL (prediction interval about 15× the estimate), and in the replay the strip card's concentration (0.130 ng/mL) disagreed with the summary table (1.060 ng/mL at 10x). The numbers show how the tool works, not real assay performance.

Scope: the LoD setup offers only the two 4-point pills (0,0.1,0.5,1.0 / 0,1,5,10); the 8- and 11-point presets and the n = 1/2/3 replicate precision buttons appear only on the Find Unknown Concentration setup

features.specific: Strip card: cropped strip with Control (purple) and Test (blue) band boxes, G−R inverted absorbance vs migration distance, shaded C/T AUC, C Area / T Area, T/C ratio, POSITIVE/NEGATIVE badge, assigned or calculated concentration, 🔍 Zoom Plot, ⬇ Download PNG

features.name: 4PL/5PL standard curve with detection-limit panel
features.general: Fit a sigmoidal dose-response model to replicate standards, choose between the 4- and 5-parameter forms with an F-test, plot the curve with mean ± SD points on a log axis, and report fit parameters, R², blank and detection limits and the usable range
features.specific: 4PL Standard Calibration Curve plot (Zoom Plot, Save Curve PNG), CLSI EP17-A2 banner (LoD, R², LoB), Mathematical Equation card with F-test, Blank Floor a / Hill Slope b / EC50 c / Saturation d, Validated Bioanalytical Ranges (LDR, saturation plateau/ULoQ, LoB, LoD)

features.name: Standards recovery and replicate precision table
features.general: For each nominal standard level, show replicate mean ± SD of the signal, the back-calculated concentration, % recovery and %CV, and flag levels outside an acceptance window
features.specific: Standards Back-Calculated Recovery table with FDA target 85–115% and PASS/FLAGGED status (SD/%CV were 0 for identical images and a constant ±0.0050 for single strips in this run)
steps: read mean ± SD and %CV per level

compare with the strip card's concentration
